svg.title: Research budget allocation at 20 GPU-hours
svg.desc: Equal nominal candidate-training budget of 20 GPU-hours per search. Candidates are counted in actual completion order. The smallest measured model with validation BPB below 2.0 is selected from that prefix, including partial generations. Baseline, attempts without complete measurements, in-flight work, and research overhead are excluded. This is not an equal wall-clock comparison. 20 minutes per candidate: 60 completed candidates, 123,272 parameters. 40 minutes per candidate: 30 completed candidates, 3,194,960 parameters. 80 minutes per candidate: 15 completed candidates, 11,542,672 parameters. 100 minutes per candidate: 12 completed candidates, 7,864,464 parameters.
